messages:
Anya: Short brief  need a compact creative pack for the launch playbook: landing hero (modular for microcarousel), three benchmark micro-tiles, a tiny routing strip for SDR handoff, and a webinar cover. Final assets by Friday EOD.
Mira: Copy. Any special treatment for hero?
Anya: Hero should work as a static banner and as a slide in a microcarousel (so include a left gutter for overlaid headline). Export as PNG + accessible alt-text layer in Figma.
Priya: Brand rules: use new tokens (deep-navy, coral, moss), Inter family. Icons: flat two-tone. Ensure AA contrast and provide alt-text strings for each export.
Zane: For benchmark tiles, prefer sparkline for cost trend + small bar for p50 latency. Limit to icon + 3 metrics + one-line takeaway. Also include a tiny "fallback" badge (icon + short text) in the corner.
Anya: Metrics: Hosted p50=89ms cost=$0.00245; Dedicated p50=66ms cost=$0.00158; Private p50=72ms cost=$0.00202. Takeaway to read: "Unified API and predictable economics"; copy note: avoid absolutes like "cheapest".
Priya: Legal: I'll draft a footnote: "Metrics based on internal Redwood performance tests, June 2025." Also suggest phrasing "most cost-efficient at scale" for Dedicated.
Mira: Routing snippet to include in the strip (will render as a tiny code card):
```
routes:
  - name: high_intent
    match: score >= 60
    action: assign_sdr + slack_alert(#sdr-high)
  - name: nurture
    match: score < 60
    action: start_drip(days=7)
```
Mira: Deliverables: Figma master (pages: hero, tiles, routing), PNG 1200x628 (social), PNG 640x360 (thumb), PNG 1920x1080 (webinar). Also provide SVG icon set and a CSV of alt-text + localized strings (en-US, en-GB).
Anya: CTA copy: Hero = "Register for benchmark webinar"; Tile link = "Read the full benchmark". Include UTM example: utm_campaign=launch_q3&utm_source=social. Growth needs final .pngs by Mon AM; Friday EOD final works.
design-bot: Asset checklist added: [Figma master file, PNG 1200x628, PNG 640x360, PNG 1920x1080, SVG icons, localization CSV, alt-text CSV, export manifest].
Mira: I'll post first draft frames Thu morning and a refined pass Thu evening. Please leave feedback as Figma comments.
Priya: I'll run brand + legal sweep Thu night.
Zane: One micro-ask: can the tiles include a small microcopy slot for an ROI stat if Growth asks? Leave an 8px gutter.
Mira: Will add reserved microcopy slot.
Anya: Thanks all  posting the content brief in the doc and will ping when draft live. :rocket:
